name: Goblin Camp Gate
_design: Fight arena (Boss 2026-10-14: 28 x 21 m, ~1.7x the first version, 2-2.5 screens at camera 8 - room to retreat, circle and kite; still ONE arena, portals north when it is cleared). Night goblin camp: the goblins' spiked palisade closes the north side and its two skull-post gates are where the exit portals stand (flagstone paths lead to them, so the way out reads before it opens). Landmarks: a goblin watchtower with a watch-fire over the north-east corner and the gates themselves; both outside the walkable box, so nothing tall can hide a fight. Six cover pieces spread over the bigger floor - totem west, moss rocks (south-east and centre-north), crate stack north-east, plank barricade north-west, log pile south-east - leave a clear ring to run and an open middle to fight in; mud patches, bones and thorn roots keep the extra floor from reading empty. The player starts south-centre; spots go near-to-far so goblins arrive first and the archer (second-last spot, far north-east) shoots from behind the crates. Built by tools/blender/build_goblin_stages.py (art and this file come from one layout; edit the script, not this file).
